crossRefs.note: Tell the righteous “Good!” For they shall eat the fruit of their deeds.
“Hey! Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters! Come, he who has no money, buy, and eat! Yes, come, buy wine and milk…
Seek Yahweh while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.
Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy…
Go, and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, ‘Return, you backsliding Israel,’ says Yahweh; ‘I will not look…
“I have surely heard Ephraim grieving thus, ‘You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as an untrained calf. Turn me…
Israel, return to Yahweh your God; for you have fallen because of your sin.
You will have plenty to eat, and be satisfied, and will praise the name of Yahweh, your God, who has dealt wondrously…
But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’
Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,

translations.web: If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the good of the land;
translations.bsb: If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the best of the land.
translations.kjv: If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land:
translations.asv: If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land:
